race.description: De Bortoli Wines, Rutherglen Mdn Hcp
race.comment: ASHEN KNIGHT (6) was plain late at Wangaratta but drops in weight and his Albury third two back ties him neatly into this field. Fitter now and has claims. DEI MIRACOLI (1) had genuine traffic issues when fourth at Albury and can be around the money if he handles 1600m for the first time. In the mix. MY BOY CRIPPA (4) improved sharply into fourth at Albury over 1500m and gets a strong local stable-rider profile. Well placed to improve again. FLASHMAN (2) was slow away and safely held when fifth on debut at Wodonga over 1400m. The claim helps as does the race experience and look for any market confidence.
